episodes.synopsis: Lux Arcadia falls into the baths of the all-girls Royal Knight Academy, and right on top of the naked Princess Lisesharte Atismata, who challenges him to a duel as penance.
episodes.title: The Crimson War Princess

episodes.synopsis: Lux begins his life at the academy and meets an old childhood friend, much to Lisesharte’s chagrin. Later, Lux and Lisesharte face old, dark memories of the recent past.
episodes.title: The Weakest Drag-Knight

episodes.synopsis: When Lisha throws Lux a party, a week of Lux’s time is offered as a game prize! The outcome could be worse, but his new position lands him in an awkward and dangerous place.
episodes.title: The Lady of the North's Engagement Conditions

episodes.synopsis: Lux mentally prepares for his duel with Lord Barzeride. Meanwhile, the nobles of the New Kingdom order an investigation of some ancient ruins which may hide a powerful Abyss.
episodes.title: The Sixth Ruin -Miniature Garden-

episodes.synopsis: Krulcifer reveals her painful past to Lux. In an act of sympathy, she decides to release him from their agreement and begins to prepare for her duel against Barzeride.
episodes.title: A Girl's Wish

episodes.synopsis: When Lux meets a high ranking noble girl under false pretenses, he’s put in a tight spot. It gets worse; she has a reputation for misandry and wants him out of the school!
episodes.title: The Homecoming of the Strongest

episodes.synopsis: The students head to a training session on the beach. However, it’s not all fun in the sun as the prowler from campus is revealed and mysteries abound as a new ruin appears.
episodes.title: A Girl's Truth

episodes.synopsis: Exploring the new ruin yields a fascinating find, but Philuffy begins to feel ill. As she and Lux are thrown into a site from their past, Lux recovers some ghastly memories.
episodes.title: Awakening of the Phantom Divine Beast

episodes.synopsis: Lux faces off against Hayes in a fight to save Philuffy’s life. With Hayes’ nefarious plans already in motion, another dark figure emerges from the shadows of the old Empire.
episodes.title: The Promise

episodes.synopsis: Lux has to choose not one, but three, dates for the National Foundation Festival. While Lisha nurses hurt feelings, a supporter of the old Empire emerges from the shadows.
episodes.title: The Young Girls' Reward

episodes.synopsis: Lux discovers that a rebellion is being plotted by a group from the old Empire, and Airi is worried as he agrees to conditions he may be unable to meet.
episodes.title: The Imperial Assassin's Dagger

episodes.synopsis: With the fate of their country and its people hanging in the balance, Lux and Lisha fight against their toughest foe yet; an enemy born of their pasts.
episodes.title: The Young Girl's Cherished Desire
